• COMMON
 
 
• 
 
C + 2 → E

 O + 2 → Q

 M + 2 → O

 M + 2 → O

 O + 2 → Q

 N + 2 → P

 
 
• Therefore, code = EQOOQP
 
 
 
• PREP
 
 
• 
 
P + 2 → R

 R + 2 → T

 E + 2 → G

 P + 2 → R

 
 
• Therefore, code = RTGR
 
 
 
• MAGNET
 
 
• 
 
M + 2 → O

 A + 2 → C

 G + 2 → I

 N + 2 → P

 E + 2 → G

 T + 2 → V

 
 
• Therefore, code = **OCIPGV**
 
 

Hence, "option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'SCHOOL' is written as 'TDIPPM' and 'COLLEGE' is written as 'DPMMFHF'. How will 'UNIVERSITY' be written in that language?

In the above code, every letter is replaced by +1 letter of them in the English alphabet series.

S (19) +1 = T (20)

C (3) + 1 = D (4)

H (8) +1 = I (9)

0 (15) +1 = P (16)

0 (15) +1 = P (16)

L (12) +1 = M (13)

**'SCHOOL'** is written as **'TDIPPM'**

C (3) + 1 = D (4)

0 (15) +1 = P (16)

L (12) +1 = M (13)

E (5) + 1 = F (6)

G (7) + 1 = H (8)

E (5) + 1 = F (6)

** 'COLLEGE'** is written as **'DPMMFHF'**

U (21) + 1 = V(22)

N (14) + 1 = O (15)

I (9) + 1 = J(10)

V (22) + 1 = W(23)

E (5) + 1 = F(6)

R (19) + 1 = S(20)

S (19) +1 = T (20)

I (9) + 1 = J(10)

T(20) +1 = U(21)

Y(25) + 1 = Z(26)

** 'UNIVERSITY**' is written as **'VOJWFSTJUZ'**

Hence, the correct answer is** **VOJWFSTJUZ.

questions.question: In certain code language, 'TRAIN' is written as 'WUDLQ' and 'ROAD' is written as "URDG'. How will 'TAXI' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

TRAIN

T + 3 → W

R + 3 → U

A + 3 → D

I + 3 → L

N + 3 → Q

​Therefore, code = WUDLQ

ROAD

R + 3 → U
O + 3 → R
A + 3 → D

D + 3 → G

Therefore, code = URDG

Similarly, TAXI

T + 3 → W

A + 3 → D

X + 3 → A

I + 3 → L

Therefore, **code = WDAL**

Hence, "**WDAL**" is the correct answer.
